visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against three individually viewed Qualla originals, the hotel floor plan and Parks Canada architecture description. The central stepped tower, long guest wings, angled end pavilions, low public rooms and Rundle cross-wing remain distinct. Review corrected buried hip-roof dormers, floating ridge details, thin gable backs and disconnected public-room blocks.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views including the footprint overlay, plus the detailed front of the preceding geometry iteration. Stone wall, limestone trim and standing-seam roof use shared metric surfaces; glass remains local. Flat ground is a material fixture; portable views retain independent terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline preserves the stepped tower and major roof masses; district restores openings; street and closeup restore dormers, gables, window frames and public-room masonry. All four levels remain within hard budgets. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped combined outline is retained; geographic controls use only the main-hotel scope cut at the narrow southern connection. Actual anchor [-115.56183,51.164332], heading -1.08: +X south-southeast, +Z west-southwest toward Spray Avenue. This replaces the displaced story point. Independent unmodified Terrarium datum 1401.9301 m uses south entrance forecourt [59,33]; foundations extend to -3 m. Footprint suppression remains off.

fidelityReview.scope: Main Banff Springs stone hotel, central tower, guest wings, angled end pavilions, public-room podiums and Rundle cross-wing.
fidelityReview.notes: Three individually inspected local Qualla originals, Parks Canada architectural description, hotel floor plan and satellite roof context control the main hotel. The official eleven-storey tower and photographic proportions guide estimated heights. Roof intersections, hidden elevations, masonry courses and fine ornament remain interpretations. Later Gatehouse/conference and pool/spa additions, landscape terraces and interiors are excluded. No photo pixels copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.
